author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Complex Cooperative Building Task - Dynamic Role Assignment (Corrected v6)
abstract: This submission, a corrected version (v6) of Eval ID: 405/408/412/414/417, aims to definitively resolve persistent issues of stalled progress in the multi-phase building task. It features a refined reward structure that provides a more direct, granular signal for each assembled component, complemented by a balanced phase completion bonus. Initial agent preferences are explicitly re-aligned to cover critical early-phase tasks. Resource capacity is increased. Dynamic events remain disabled to ensure robust emergent specialization and coordination across sequential cooperative building phases, aiming for full structure completion.
